Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our plan, I want to kick off a short renewal orchestration thread so we can lock stakeholders, timelines, and the QBR window. High-level goals:

- Agree on target term and uplift options (headroom vs committed capacity)
- Schedule a QBR + technical capacity scoping session in the next 2–3 weeks
- Outline procurement/legal timeline so we don’t hit last-minute delays

Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan that lists the items we expect to cover. Can you confirm:
1) who on your side should join the QBR (exec readout + procurement + technical leads),
2) whether procurement needs a separate kickoff before the QBR, and
3) preferred windows next week (I dropped a quick poll here: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-starlite-qbr).

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- May 10–12 (afternoons)
- May 17–19 (mornings)

If those are tight, we can do an accelerated 45-minute scoping call followed by a longer QBR. Next steps from our side after your confirmation: we’ll share a compact capacity model and a recommended uplift ladder (burst vs committed tiers) and have Legal pre-seed any necessary term language.
